notes.title: A Berry Good Update 🍓
notes.notes:
Prepare for an epic showdown in the latest Banana Cowboy update as you take on the notorious Strawberry Mafia and bring justice to the newly discovered Strawberry Planet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/8cea9e681bab40c48777cc08c00deccd8d226dd6.png

Previous versions of Banana Cowboy will be posted to our Itch.io page for any speedrunners who wish to compete against older runs. Post your own speedrun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002906/0f5af5401d7d7567a2cd3c7a3e0bb5c775f25d74.png

Added:

 New Strawberry Mafia world with a new boss fight
 New Shooter Strawberry Enemy
 More Hats and Color skins for Banana Cowboy
 Speedrun tracker on the level-select screen to see which levels have been completed
 4 new achievements
 And More!


Changes and Bug Fixes:

 All enemies are now thrown with the same force (previously blueberry enemies were thrown with a weaker force than the orange enemy)
 Comic cutscenes now show the page number when played
 Fixed a bug where the second phase of the blender boss fight could be skipped by pressing space after punching the boss
 Fixed bug where the player could stand in the center of the blender blade indefinitely
 Fixed bug where the entirety of the Orange Level platforming could be skipped
 Camera now moves / rotates faster
 And More!
